name: address
description: What sits at a network's address: the gateway, the relay, the signer, the web client's files and the way in for outsiders.

scripts.dev: wrangler dev -c gateway/wrangler.jsonc -c relay/wrangler.jsonc -c signer/wrangler.jsonc -c way-in/wrangler.jsonc -c web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: for piece in web signer relay way-in gateway; do wrangler deploy -c $piece/wrangler.jsonc || exit; done
